newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Two jailed Tunisian opposition leaders freed.
newsitem.headline: Two jailed Tunisian opposition leaders freed.

text.p: Two jailed Tunisian opposition leaders, Khemais Chammari and Mohamed Moada, were released on Monday night, lawyers and judicial sources said.

Moada, former president of the main Tunisian opposition party Movement of Social Democrats (MDS), was sentenced last February to 11 years in jail on charges of having secret contacts with Libyan agents.
Chammari, vice-president of MDS, was sentenced last July to five years in jail for disclosing secrets of judicial proceedings in Moada's case.
The sources said the two were freed for "humanitarian reasons". No other details were immediately available.
